newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales fall 7.8 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales fall 7.8 pct in September.

text.p: Retail sales in Switzerland, measured by value, fell 7.8 percent in September from the same month last year after a year-on-year fall of 2.4 percent in August and a 0.5 percent fall in September last year, the Federal Statistics Office said.

The office said in a statement that there was one less shopping day in September this year than last year, resulting in a decline in sales of 4.1 percent per shopping day. Adjusted for inflation, the office said real retail turnover in September was 7.6 percent lower than last year, with sales of foods down 6.2 percent and clothes and textiles down by 8.9 percent.
For the first nine months of the year, the value of retail sales was 1.7 percent lower than in the same 1995 period.
Adjusted for prices, the office said real sales fell 1.7 percent in the first nine months of 1996 from the same 1995 period.

In the third quarter alone, the value of retail sales fell 3.6 percent comapred with a rise of 0.3 percent in the third quarter of 1995. On a price-adjusted basis retail sales fell 3.4 percent in the third quarter, while they were unchanged in the 1995 third quarter.
